context_for_next_testing_agent: App is stable and green end-to-end. Leaflet double-init was the only critical blocker and is fixed. If future tests add Leaflet to new routes, wrap them in <ErrorBoundary/> as done in DashboardLayout. AI Analysis needs ~25s wait. Predictions map uses react-leaflet CircleMarker (overlay paths) not SVG rects.
rca of the issue: No new bugs. Iteration_2 Leaflet issue RCA was: React.StrictMode caused double mount in dev which re-initialised the same DOM node used by Leaflet -> 'Map container is already initialized'. Fix (already applied by main agent): (1) remove <React.StrictMode> from index.js, (2) add ErrorBoundary around <Outlet/> in DashboardLayout to contain any future map errors, (3) move post-login redirect into useEffect in Login.jsx to avoid navigating during render. Re-verified: no console errors, no pageerrors, ErrorBoundary count=0 across all pages.
